/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/1999TankHood.name: H-09 Apex Turret Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/1999TankHood.description: The smoldering turret of an H-09 Apex Scaldra tank shall adorn your Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/1999TankHood.descriptionEn: The smoldering turret of an H-09 Apex Scaldra tank shall adorn your Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/1999TankHood.descriptionZh: 这座冒着烟的 H-09 炽蛇军王者坦克炮台将装饰你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ConquestHood.name: Archimedean Eye Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ConquestHood.description: An ornament awarded only to the most dedicated of researchers. Said by some to be representative of the eye of an ancient deity, sacrificed in return for wisdom.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ConquestHood.descriptionEn: An ornament awarded only to the most dedicated of researchers. Said by some to be representative of the eye of an ancient deity, sacrificed in return for wisdom.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/ConquestHood.descriptionZh: 只有最敬业的研究者才能获得的饰物。有人说，它代表了古代神灵的眼睛，为换取智慧而牺牲。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/CryobellHood.name: Cryobell Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/CryobellHood.description: A mysterious glacial bell, awarded to commemorate defiance in the face of adversity.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/CryobellHood.descriptionZh: 一只神秘的冰霜之铃，为了纪念身处逆境仍不屈抗争的意志。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/DuelistHoodO.name: Niveus Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/DuelistHoodO.description: The icy frisson of your presence precedes you into battle.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/DuelistHoodO.descriptionZh: 你令人不寒而栗的气息在你踏入战场之前便已蔓延开来。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/InfChargerHo.name: Charger Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/InfChargerHo.description: With the head of an Infested Charger mounted at the front of your craft, you’ll make an instant impression on your enemies.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/InfChargerHo.descriptionEn: With the head of an Infested Charger mounted at the front of your craft, you’ll make an instant impression on your enemies.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/InfChargerHo.descriptionZh: 用疾冲者的头颅装饰你的登陆艇，给你的敌人留下刻骨铭心的记忆。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/LisetDOTDSki.name: Liset Calaverita Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/LisetDOTDSki.description: Approaching battle becomes a cause for celebration with this festively painted Liset skin.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/LisetDOTDSki.descriptionZh: 有了这款充满节日气氛的登陆艇外观，即将到来的战斗也变成了值得庆祝的事情。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/LisetDuelist.name: Niveus Liset Skin
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/LisetDuelist.description: A chilling skin for the Liset landing craft.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/LisetDuelist.descriptionZh: 令人毛骨悚然的 Liset 登陆艇外观。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MaduraiHoodO.name: Madurai Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MaduraiHoodO.description: Adorn your Landing Craft with the Madurai cloud.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MaduraiHoodO.descriptionZh: 通过 Madurai 之云装饰你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MasteryHoodO.name: True Master Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MasteryHoodO.description: This Sumdali hull ornament is awarded exclusively to Tenno who have earned the rank of True Master.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MasteryHoodO.descriptionEn: This Sumdali hull ornament is awarded exclusively to Tenno who have earned the rank of True Master.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MasteryHoodO.descriptionZh: 这款船徽装饰是专门授予获得了至崇宗师段位的 Tenno 的。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MITWHoodOrna.name: Manus Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MITWHoodOrna.description: Ominous hands grace your Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MITWHoodOrna.descriptionEn: Ominous hands grace your Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/MITWHoodOrna.descriptionZh: 不祥之手为你的登陆艇增色。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/Mustache05Ho.name: Tusker Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/Mustache05Ho.description: Display this stylish Lander hull ornament proudly.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/Mustache05Ho.descriptionZh: 自豪地展示这款时尚的着陆器船徽装饰。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/NaramonHoodO.name: Naramon Sumdali

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/OrfeoHoodOrn.name: Chivaler Sumdali

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/OrfeoHoodOrn.descriptionZh: 装备这枚骑士风范的船徽，冲锋在前。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/PeritaHoodOr.name: Mentor Ayatan Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/PeritaHoodOr.description: Bestowed in commemoration of exceptional battlefield achievement. Purged of any malicious code.

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/PeritaHoodOr.descriptionZh: 为表彰卓越的战场功绩而授予。已清除所有恶意代码。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/PraghasaHood.name: Khadati Sumdali
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/PraghasaHood.description: A broken shard of Praghasa, splintered from her body and now adorning your landing craft.
/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/PraghasaHood.descriptionZh: 「布拉喀萨」身上脱落下来的一块碎片，如今装饰着你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/StalkerHoodO.name: Stalker's Mark Sumdali

/Lotus/Upgrades/Skins/Liset/StalkerHoodO.descriptionZh: 向宇宙宣告你身上带着死亡的印记。
